rationale.A: Paths beside Itäväylä/Kulosaarensilta, 1.1 km mixed on 30 km/h Kulosaaren puistotie, 380 m on Sompasaarenlaituri; 3 lights
rationale.B: Like A but 470 m on Capellan puistotie and a Hakaniemi square detour; more unsignalised crossings; 4 lights
rationale.C: Same corridor as A, using the path beside Sompasaarenlaituri instead of the road; only Kulosaaren puistotie in traffic; 2 lights
rationale.D: Like B to Merihaka, then Pohjoisranta path and Kruununhaka streets; 4 lights
rationale.E: Through Sörnäinen on paths beside Sörnäisten rantatie (50 km/h); less mixed traffic than A but 8 lights
rationale.F: Through Vilhonvuori and Kallio paths; 1.2 km in traffic (mostly Kulosaaren puistotie); 9 lights
rationale.G: Avoids Kulosaaren puistotie via Kulosaari side streets and Mustikkamaa, but ~830 m in traffic and an unsignalised trunk-road crossing; +8 min
rationale.H: Via Hermannin rantatie (270 m in traffic) and paths beside Sörnäisten rantatie; 11 lights; +9 min

notes: Every option rides Kulosaaren puistotie or the main road corridors; no candidate gives a clear tier gain over A. C saves only one light.
